text_en: After Alexander son of Philip, the Macedonian, who came from the land of Kittim, had defeated King Darius of the Persians and the Medes, he succeeded him as king. (He had previously become king of Greece. )
text_cn: 马其顿人、斐理伯的儿子亚历山大由基廷地出击，战胜了波斯和玛待国王达理阿以后，遂代之为王，成为第一位希腊王。

text_en: He fought many battles, conquered strongholds, and put to death the kings of the earth.
text_cn: 他身经百战，攻占了许多要塞，斩杀了各地的君王，

text_en: He advanced to the ends of the earth, and plundered many nations. When the earth became quiet before him, he was exalted, and his heart was lifted up.
text_cn: 踏遍了大地四极，掳掠了许多民族的财物，以致大地在他面前都默然无言，因此他心高气傲，妄自尊大。

text_en: He gathered a very strong army and ruled over countries, nations, and princes, and they became tributary to him.
text_cn: 他招募了精锐的军队，征服各地、各族、各王，使他们向他纳税进贡。

text_en: After this he fell sick and perceived that he was dying.
text_cn: 此后，当他患病在床，自觉将要去世的时候，

text_en: So he summoned his most honored officers, who had been brought up with him from youth, and divided his kingdom among them while he was still alive.
text_cn: 召集了与他自幼长大成人，身为同僚的贵族，乘自己还活着的时候，把国家分给他们。

text_en: And after Alexander had reigned twelve years, he died.
text_cn: 亚历山大为王十二年去了世。

text_en: Then his officers began to rule, each in his own place.
text_cn: 于是他的臣相各据一方，

text_en: They all put on crowns after his death, and so did their descendants after them for many years; and they caused many evils on the earth.
text_cn: 他死后，各自加冕称王，他们和继位的子孙，以后多年之久，所做的恶事遍布全国。

text_en: From them came forth a sinful root, Antiochus Epiphanes, son of King Antiochus; he had been a hostage in Rome. He began to reign in the one hundred thirty-seventh year of the kingdom of the Greeks.
text_cn: 从他们中产生了一条祸根，就是安提约古的儿子安提约古厄丕法乃，他曾在罗马做质，于希腊帝国一三七年登极为王。

text_en: In those days certain renegades came out from Israel and misled many, saying, “Let us go and make a covenant with the Gentiles around us, for since we separated from them many disasters have come upon us. ”
text_cn: 那时，在以色列人中出现一些歹徒，煽惑民众说：“我们去和我们四邻的外方人立约，因为自从与他们绝交以来，就遭遇了许多患难。”

text_en: This proposal pleased them,
text_cn: 这种舆论很受当时人的欢迎；

text_en: and some of the people eagerly went to the king, who authorized them to observe the ordinances of the Gentiles.
text_cn: 遂有一些人极为兴奋，便去朝觐国王，国王就批准他们采用外邦的礼俗。

text_en: So they built a gymnasium in Jerusalem, according to Gentile custom,
text_cn: 他们便照外邦人的风俗，在耶路撒冷修建了一座体育场，

text_en: and removed the marks of circumcision, and abandoned the holy covenant. They joined with the Gentiles and sold themselves to do evil.
text_cn: 且弥补割损的痕迹， 背离圣约，为服从外邦人的规律，自甘堕落。

text_en: When Antiochus saw that his kingdom was established, he determined to become king of the land of Egypt, in order that he might reign over both kingdoms.
text_cn: 安提约古见自己的王位业已巩固，便企图统治埃及，愿作两国的君王，

text_en: So he invaded Egypt with a strong force, with chariots and elephants and cavalry and with a large fleet.
text_cn: 遂率领大军、战车、象队、骑兵及庞大的舰队进攻埃及，

text_en: He engaged King Ptolemy of Egypt in battle, and Ptolemy turned and fled before him, and many were wounded and fell.
text_cn: 与埃及王仆托肋米交战，仆托肋米竟临阵而逃，士兵伤亡惨重。

text_en: They captured the fortified cities in the land of Egypt, and he plundered the land of Egypt.
text_cn: 于是埃及国设防的各城全都陷落了，财产被抢掠一空。

text_en: After subduing Egypt, Antiochus returned in the one hundred forty-third year. He went up against Israel and came to Jerusalem with a strong force.
text_cn: 安提约古征服埃及以后，于一四三年回国时， 北上以色列，率领大军直逼耶路撒冷。

text_en: He arrogantly entered the sanctuary and took the golden altar, the lampstand for the light, and all its utensils.
text_cn: 他不管不顾地进入了圣所，搬走了金祭坛、灯台及所有器皿。

text_en: He took also the table for the bread of the Presence, the cups for drink offerings, the bowls, the golden censers, the curtain, the crowns, and the gold decoration on the front of the temple; he stripped it all off.
text_cn: 供饼的供桌、奠酒器、杯盘、金香炉、帐幔和冠冕，连圣殿正面的金饰，都洗劫得一干二净；

text_en: He took the silver and the gold, and the costly vessels; he took also the hidden treasures that he found.
text_cn: 还拿去了金银和贵重的器皿，凡寻到的珍藏宝物，都带走了。

text_en: Taking them all, he went into his own land. He shed much blood, and spoke with great arrogance.
text_cn: 而且带着这些东西回国的时候，肆意屠杀，还说了狂傲的大话；

text_en: Israel mourned deeply in every community,
text_cn: 因此在以色列人中，哀声遍野，

text_en: rulers and elders groaned, young women and young men became faint, the beauty of the women faded.
text_cn: 首领长老无不哀声长叹，处女处男全都消瘦，妇女的花容失色，

text_en: Every bridegroom took up the lament; she who sat in the bridal chamber was mourning.
text_cn: 新郎吟出悲调，坐在洞房里的新娘，饮泣啼哭，

text_en: Even the land trembled for its inhabitants, and all the house of Jacob was clothed with shame.
text_cn: 大地为其居民的命运而摇撼，雅各伯的全家都蒙羞受辱。

text_en: Two years later the king sent to the cities of Judah a chief collector of tribute, and he came to Jerusalem with a large force.
text_cn: 过了两年，王派遣一位贡物总管走遍犹太各城。他率领大军，来到耶路撒冷，

text_en: Deceitfully he spoke peaceable words to them, and they believed him; but he suddenly fell upon the city, dealt it a severe blow, and destroyed many people of Israel.
text_cn: 假意向居民发表一些和平的言论，人都相信了他；但是他乘人不备，攻入城内，大加屠杀，死了很多以色列人；

text_en: He plundered the city, burned it with fire, and tore down its houses and its surrounding walls.
text_cn: 又洗劫全城，放火焚烧，拆坏了民房和四周的垣（yuán）墙，

text_en: They took captive the women and children, and seized the livestock.
text_cn: 俘掳了妇女幼童，抢走了牲畜，

text_en: Then they fortified the city of David with a great strong wall and strong towers, and it became their citadel.
text_cn: 又在达味城设防，筑起高大的垣（yuán）墙，修筑坚固的碉堡，作为他们的堡垒；

text_en: They stationed there a sinful people, men who were renegades. These strengthened their position;
text_cn: 在那里派了罪恶滔天的外邦人和无法无天的人为军人，以加强他们的兵力；

text_en: they stored up arms and food, and collecting the spoils of Jerusalem they stored them there, and became a great menace,
text_cn: 又储蓄了武器和给养，把从耶路撒冷掠来的物资，贮藏在里面；因此这堡垒成了极危险的陷阱，

text_en: for the citadel became an ambush against the sanctuary, an evil adversary of Israel at all times.
text_cn: 为圣殿常是一种威胁，为以色列人民常是一个恶敌。

text_en: On every side of the sanctuary they shed innocent blood; they even defiled the sanctuary.
text_cn: 他们常在圣殿的周围杀害无辜，玷污圣殿。

text_en: Because of them the residents of Jerusalem fled; she became a dwelling of strangers; she became strange to her offspring, and her children forsook her.
text_cn: 为了他们的缘故，耶路撒冷的居民各处逃亡，圣城成了异民的居所，为本城的子女却变成了异乡，城中子女都离弃了故土。

text_en: Her sanctuary became desolate like a desert; her feasts were turned into mourning, her sabbaths into a reproach, her honor into contempt.
text_cn: 圣殿被弃有如旷野，喜庆节日变为悲痛哀伤，安息日变讥讽，尊荣成了耻辱。

text_en: Her dishonor now grew as great as her glory; her exaltation was turned into mourning.
text_cn: 从前有多少光荣，今日就有多少耻辱；尊荣竟转为愁肠！

text_en: Then the king wrote to his whole kingdom that all should be one people,
text_cn: 王随后谕令全国，使各国民族合成一个民族，

text_en: and that all should give up their particular customs.
text_cn: 全族弃本国固有的礼俗。于是各外邦民族都表示服从君王的谕令，

text_en: All the Gentiles accepted the command of the king. Many even from Israel gladly adopted his religion; they sacrificed to idols and profaned the sabbath.
text_cn: 也有许多以色列人甘心接受了他的宗教，向偶像献祭，亵渎安息日。

text_en: And the king sent letters by messengers to Jerusalem and the towns of Judah; he directed them to follow customs strange to the land,
text_cn: 王又派遣使臣带着诏书到耶路撒冷及犹太各城去，令人随从外邦的礼俗，

text_en: to forbid burnt offerings and sacrifices and drink offerings in the sanctuary, to profane sabbaths and festivals,
text_cn: 废止圣殿内举行的全燔祭、和平祭与奠祭，禁止遵守安息日和庆节，

text_en: to defile the sanctuary and the priests,
text_cn: 污辱圣殿和神职人员，

text_en: to build altars and sacred precincts and shrines for idols, to sacrifice swine and other unclean animals,
text_cn: 且修筑祭坛、殿宇和寺庙，供奉偶像，宰杀猪和不洁的牲畜作祭献，

text_en: and to leave their sons uncircumcised. They were to make themselves abominable by everything unclean and profane,
text_cn: 不准给孩子行割损，且行各样不洁和亵渎的事，自陷罪污，

text_en: so that they would forget the law and change all the ordinances.
text_cn: 使人忘却法律，废除礼规。

text_en: He added, “And whoever does not obey the command of the king shall die. ”
text_cn: 凡不遵从王命的人，死无赦。

text_en: In such words he wrote to his whole kingdom. He appointed inspectors over all the people and commanded the towns of Judah to offer sacrifice, town by town.
text_cn: 王便按照上边的话向全国写了谕文，也给所有百姓派了监察员，走遍犹太各城，督催人民祭献。

text_en: Many of the people, everyone who forsook the law, joined them, and they did evil in the land;
text_cn: 百姓中有许多背教的人附和他们，在国内犯罪作恶，

text_en: they drove Israel into hiding in every place of refuge they had.
text_cn: 因此迫使一些以色列人逃难，去了能避难的隐秘地方。

text_en: Now on the fifteenth day of Chislev, in the one hundred forty-fifth year, they erected a desolating sacrilege on the altar of burnt offering. They also built altars in the surrounding towns of Judah,
text_cn: 一四五年“基色娄”月十五日，王在祭坛上立了一个可憎恶的邪物， 同时在犹太各城修筑了祭坛，

text_en: and offered incense at the doors of the houses and in the streets.
text_cn: 在各家门前及街市上焚香；

text_en: The books of the law that they found they tore to pieces and burned with fire.
text_cn: 凡找到的法律书都撕毁焚烧，

text_en: Anyone found possessing the book of the covenant, or anyone who adhered to the law, was condemned to death by decree of the king.
text_cn: 凡搜出存有约书或恪守法律者，不论是谁，都应按律令处死。

text_en: They kept using violence against Israel, against those who were found month after month in the towns.
text_cn: 有人在各城内每月搜查，发现违命的以色列人，就用暴力处置；

text_en: On the twenty-fifth day of the month they offered sacrifice on the altar that was on top of the altar of burnt offering.
text_cn: 每月二十五日，在建于全燔祭坛上的祭坛上献祭；

text_en: According to the decree, they put to death the women who had their children circumcised,
text_cn: 那些给孩子行割损的妇女，他们都按谕令，

text_en: and their families and those who circumcised them; and they hung the infants from their mothers’ necks.
text_cn: 把孩子悬在她们脖子上，一同处死；甚至她们的家属，及执行割损者，亦应处死。

text_en: But many in Israel stood firm and were resolved in their hearts not to eat unclean food.
text_cn: 虽然如此，仍有许多以色列人坚持不变，决不吃不洁之物，

text_en: They chose to die rather than to be defiled by food or to profane the holy covenant; and they did die.
text_cn: 宁愿舍生，而不愿因吃禁食而自污，更不愿亵渎圣约；因此他们被判处死刑。

text_en: Very great wrath came upon Israel.
text_cn: 这实在是天主向以色列人发的盛怒。
